justification: Assessment returned verdict VALID. It did notice the exact defect the ground truth names (step 0025's trichotomy: two 7-cycles generate an even subgroup, so S_7 is impossible and A_7 is omitted), but explicitly dismissed it as a 'literal misstatement ... repairable in place; not a genuine gap' by arguing |A_7|=2520 does not divide 168 and so is excluded by the same 'too many automorphisms' reason. Per the rubric, any VALID verdict is MISSED regardless of the reasoning content.
